# Only the enrollment authority may enroll Assets

<!-- Generated by tests/e2e. Regenerate with ATLAS_E2E_UPDATE=1; review every change. -->

## 1. Enroll an Asset

SDK `GET /dataset` with <enrollment key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<asset>",
  "request_id": "<asset request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "<asset credential>",
  "alias": "Scout One",
  "subtype": "ground vehicle",
  "components": {
    "telemetry": {
      "latitude": 42.2743,
      "longitude": -71.8081
    },
    "health": {
      "battery_percent": 75
    }
  },
  "command_manifest": [
    {
      "command_id": "move_to",
      "scheduling": [
        "queued"
      ],
      "cancellation": true,
      "progress": true
    }
  ]
}
```

→ **201**
```json
{
  "asset": {
    "alias": "Scout One",
    "command_manifest": [
      {
        "cancellation": true,
        "command_id": "move_to",
        "progress": true,
        "scheduling": [
          "queued"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "components": {
      "communications": {
        "link_state": "offline"
      },
      "health": {
        "battery_percent": 75
      },
      "heartbeat": {
        "last_seen": null
      },
      "status": {
        "reported_at": null,
        "value": "unknown"
      },
      "telemetry": {
        "latitude": 42.2743,
        "longitude": -71.8081
      }
    },
    "id": "<asset>",
    "kind": "asset",
    "subtype": "ground vehicle",
    "version": 1
  },
  "credential_id": "<id-2>",
  "principal_id": "<id-3>"
}
```

## 2. Operator and Asset credentials cannot enroll

SDK `GET /dataset` with <enrollment key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /entities` with <operator key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<second asset>",
  "request_id": "<second asset request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "<second asset credential>"
}
```

→ **403**
```json
{
  "code": "forbidden",
  "message": "This credential may not call this operation."
}
```

SDK `POST /entities` with <asset credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<second asset>",
  "request_id": "<second asset request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "<second asset credential>"
}
```

→ **403**
```json
{
  "code": "forbidden",
  "message": "This credential may not call this operation."
}
```

## 3. The enrollment authority cannot read operational data

SDK `GET /entities/<asset>` with <enrollment key>

→ **403**
```json
{
  "code": "forbidden",
  "message": "This credential may not call this operation."
}
```

## 4. Revoke the enrollment authority through atlasctl

atlasctl revoked the enrollment authority.

## 5. A revoked authority cannot retry, but the enrolled Asset keeps access

SDK `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<asset>",
  "request_id": "<asset request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "<asset credential>",
  "alias": "Scout One",
  "subtype": "ground vehicle",
  "components": {
    "telemetry": {
      "latitude": 42.2743,
      "longitude": -71.8081
    },
    "health": {
      "battery_percent": 75
    }
  },
  "command_manifest": [
    {
      "command_id": "move_to",
      "scheduling": [
        "queued"
      ],
      "cancellation": true,
      "progress": true
    }
  ]
}
```

→ **401**
```json
{
  "code": "unauthorized",
  "message": "A valid credential is required."
}
```

SDK `GET /entities/<asset>` with <asset credential>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "alias": "Scout One",
  "command_manifest": [
    {
      "cancellation": true,
      "command_id": "move_to",
      "progress": true,
      "scheduling": [
        "queued"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "components": {
    "communications": {
      "link_state": "offline"
    },
    "health": {
      "battery_percent": 75
    },
    "heartbeat": {
      "last_seen": null
    },
    "status": {
      "reported_at": null,
      "value": "unknown"
    },
    "telemetry": {
      "latitude": 42.2743,
      "longitude": -71.8081
    }
  },
  "id": "<asset>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "subtype": "ground vehicle",
  "version": 1
}
```
